name: Sustainability in Fibres and Textile Chemical Processing
description: Principles and practices of sustainability in textile fibers and chemical processing. Environmental and social impact of fiber production: natural, synthetic, and new alternative materials. Sustainable fibres, pre-treatment, dyeing, finishing, and wastewater management. Resource efficiency and circular economy concepts. Life cycle assessment methodologies, evaluation of environmental impacts, sustainable product development, textile industry impact analysis and sustainability reports. Development of eco-friendly products and processes. Environmental standards - OekoTex, GOTS, ISO 14040 and ISO 14044, Bluesign.
